root_cause.observed: At the time the auto-integrator's preflight ran for OPS-SUPERVISOR-DISPATCH-RECONCILIATION-CORRECTIVE-001, the tempfile probe against that checkout root failed, so preflight_repository correctly returned the fail-closed 'repository-checkout-not-writable' rejection and the auto-integrator opened this unblock task instead of attempting an unsafe merge.
root_cause.current_state: By inspection time the same directory (stat'd below) is present, owned by this worker's own user/group, and mode 0775 (drwxrwxr-x) -- i.e. currently writable. Its Modify timestamp (15:20:22Z) postdates the PR #5771 merge (15:16:48Z), consistent with the auto-integrator itself successfully writing into that checkout root once materialization/propagation caught up and completing the integration on a later retry rather than the first preflight attempt.
root_cause.inference: This was a transient materialization/propagation race in the external worker-runtime checkout provisioning (outside scripts/git/auto_integrator.py and outside this task's artifact contract), not a defect in the writability check itself: _directory_is_writable() correctly proved the directory was not yet write-capable at that moment and fail-closed instead of attempting a merge into a checkout that could not safely stage it. No incorrect merge, partial write, or corrupted checkout resulted.

resolution.reason_no_code_change: The writability preflight behaved correctly (fail-closed on a genuinely not-yet-writable checkout at that instant); a subsequent retry cycle found the same checkout root writable and completed the merge and canonical closeout for the source task before this corrective task began implementation. Changing preflight_repository()/_directory_is_writable() is not warranted: they already proved the correct precondition at the time they ran, and no repository-tracked defect caused or is needed to fix the transient state.
resolution.action_taken: No merge, rebase, or PR update was required: PR #5771 is already merged into dev and OPS-SUPERVISOR-DISPATCH-RECONCILIATION-CORRECTIVE-001 is already archived done. This task documents the root cause and confirms the original PR is not stranded.
